Cases.Name: danger-single-40

EffectProfile.Summary: Reveal this card; discard one uniformly random card from the entire hand, including this card. If it has the same canonical identity, only discard it; otherwise remove this source from hand and draw 1. Repeatable; discard triggers do not resolve.

Exact results apply to this base-only model; omitted effects are not Fast uncertainty.
